answer: Each identity locks 60 credits in a lagoon vault as four 15-credit bonds, one per category: delivery, audit, analysis, outreach. The echo ledger lists tasks by category for recount. Showing fewer than four categories in an epoch forfeits 15 credits per missing category. The kth fake still needs its own 60 lock and burns 45 per epoch, so 1,000 single-category bots lock 60,000 and burn 45,000 per epoch, unpooled. An honest identity doing varied work keeps its 60. Rented output fails the summit check: each task needs a summit receipt signed by its client key; copied receipts void both bonds.
